caption: The drawing features a detailed rendering of a sculpted animal head, centered on a plain, unadorned background. The depicted head has features resembling a feline or canine, with a broad snout, wide round eyes, prominent nostrils, and an open mouth showing pronounced teeth or fangs. The ears are upright and slightly pointed. The object appears to be three-dimensional, as emphasized by meticulous shading, highlights, and the use of gradations in tone, primarily in a monochromatic palette of grays. The surface of the head shows textured lines and block-like segments, suggesting a wooden or carved material. The overall composition is centered, with the head oriented at a slight angle, showing three-quarters of the face, and no other objects or elements appear in the drawing.
title: Carved Cat Head Gargoyle
